title: 献淮宁军节度使李相公
author: 刘长卿
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. The central and lower 65% must be almost blank warm ivory writing paper for separately rendered poem text. No strong shapes below that area; tiny pale motifs at outermost bottom corners only if truly needed. All four paper edges are full bleed: no frame, rectangular picture boundary, green outer border, UI, collage, modern objects, written characters, title, calligraphy, stamp, seal, logo or watermark. Specific scene: A dignified Tang commander on a white horse riding west across fine spring grass, orderly military standards and a few scholar visitors near a distant camp gate. Civil and martial poise, no actual battle.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 献淮宁军节度使李相公 — 刘长卿
建牙吹角不闻喧，三十登坛众所尊。
家散万金酬士死，身留一剑答君恩。
渔阳老将多回席，鲁国诸生半在门。
白马翩翩春草细，郊原西去猎平原。
visualReview: 将领策马、旌旗与文士队伍表现文武兼资，未加入战斗，青草春色与明亮纸面协调。
